If it still happens to you I would love to hear how to reproduce so I can kill that bug!

notes.title: Patch 1.16
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Toybox 2, Around the block - Fixed marble getting stuck in some situations at the end of purple section
[*] Dungeon 1, Fire in the hole - Fixed Orange stairs causing marble to respawn while on stairs
[*] Added restart level to the pause menu
[/list]

I received a lot of feedback requesting a restart to make all gold runs more achievable and to restart if you missed some coins. You can only restart the current level not go back to previous levels. I hope this makes unlocking all the marbles much more enjoyable.

notes.title: Patch 1.08
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Ability to resume a course added
[*] Improvement to the way the main menu works. You can now access everything with a single button (A for controller or Enter/Return for keyboard). X/Space continues to work as it did before.
[*] Minor adjustments to levels to remove some places it was possible to get stuck
[/list]

Resume only works for the last game you quit. I am aware some people might prefer to select individual levels however I want to keep the course method for grouping levels. I hoping this is a happy compromise and lets you play a few levels and return to it later.

Discord link: https://discord.com/invite/6WpbTNX34z Links to my other socials: https://linktr.ee/DestinedLinks

notes.title: Patch 1.07
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Some people have been getting "soft blocked" where they can't start the level. I am still working on the cause, but you can now start the level from the pause level if needed. 
[*] Dungeon 9 - Possible to lose momentum on second half of green section. This has  been fixed.
[*] When unlocking the 5 second or better than gold marble for each course it always showed cats eye as the unlocked marble when it was actually a different marble being unlocked. This is now been fixed. 
[/list]

I want to thank everyone for playing and being so helpful in letting me know about bugs. I will continue to fix these as reported. Many people have wanted a resume this feature and this is in the works. 

Discord link: https://discord.com/invite/6WpbTNX34z Links to my other socials: https://linktr.ee/DestinedLinks

notes.title: Patch 1.06
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Machine 4, Highs and Low - Marble can lose momentum on the silver bar in the pinball section. This has been fixed.
[*] Dungeon 9, Dungeon Crawl - Marble gets stuck when failing last puzzle. This has been fixed. 
[/list]

I am always happy to hear feedback and will endevour to fix reported bugs as quickly as I can. I am Aussie so I will mainly be doing and available during the Aussie daytimes. I am happy to take feedback however you want to reach me but joining my discord will allow easier discussions.

notes.title: Patch 1.05

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Toybox 3, Rolling in Disguise - The covered maze was tricky to exit. This has been made much easier so you don't get stuck!
[*]Toybox 6, The Loop Around - The dish at the end if you entered the wrong way would fire the marble off into the distance. This no longer happens :)
[*]Machine 1, Crane Control - People were finding the crane was too hard and the marble was falling thru the fall. This has been adjusted to stop that. 
[*]Icons on main menu buttons adjusted to improve readability.
[*]Help adjusted to make it clear you can use mouse or touch screen to navigate menus.
[*]Reduced Bobbycopter (or Rescue bot as it is becoming known) "weeeeewaaaahh" sound has been reduced. It seems people have needed it's help a lot and it has become a bit much.
[/list]

I am always happy to hear feedback and will endevour to fix reported bugs as quickly as I can. I am Aussie so I will mainly be doing and available during the Aussie daytimes. I am happy to take feedback however you want to reach me but joining my discord will allow easier discussions.
